title: EnderCraft-Server
description:
这是一个好玩，多人，温馨的服务器
This is a good, multi-player warm server
body:
**EnderCraft服务器**，由Ender_drate创建，**始创于2022年**，截至目前**已经3周年**。是一个**温暖、养老、多玩法**的群组服务器。 包含**创造、生存、决斗**等多种玩法，目前由**创造服、创造二服、澪之境和决斗服务器组成**。服务器IP: **mc.yxzhou.com**。 在这里，时间有了新的刻度；在这里，你不再是现实的访客，而是新世界的造物主。**推开这扇门吧**，你的另一个生命已经等待了太久。

The **EnderCraft** server, created by Ender_drate, was **established in 2022** and has now celebrated its 3rd anniversary. **It is a warm, welcoming, and versatile group server** offering **various game modes such as creative, survival, and duel.** Currently, it consists of the **creative server, creative server 2, Ling's Realm, and the duel server**. The server IP is **mc.yxzhou.com**. Here, time takes on a new dimension; here, you are no longer a mere visitor to reality, but a creator in a new world. Push open this door, for your other life has been waiting for too long.
